title: KR.AI – Autonomous Meeting Intelligence Agent
description: An AI-powered assistant that converts unstructured meeting conversations into structured, actionable insights. Features include cognitive summarization, task extraction, context-aware decision-making, real-time Zoom interception via Chrome Extension, RAG-based contextual memory, multi-format input support, and one-click email sharing.

title: Uber Clone Application – MERN Stack
description: A full-stack ride-hailing platform inspired by Uber, built using the MERN stack. Includes secure authentication for users and captains, JWT-based authorization, role-based access control, MongoDB schemas, token blacklisting, protected routes, and production-level backend practices.

title: macOS-Inspired Interactive Portfolio Website
description: A macOS-style interactive portfolio website featuring a desktop-like UI experience. Includes draggable and resizable windows, dock navigation, and interactive applications such as Resume Viewer, GitHub Browser, Notes, and a Terminal CLI.
